purpose: Clarify measurement before dispatch; no task or outcome-dependent selection changes.
commonControls: All arms use identical per-task Git HEAD and the same absolute workspace path sequentially.
Frozen SDK/core/provider executable byte hashes, compiled runtime and runner, prompts, task inputs, tool-schema hashes and dependency manifest are retained.

Observer records tracked and untracked source byte fingerprints at every tool start and finish; generated .blame and dependency state are excluded. Observation overhead is measured separately and not silently subtracted.

Native required checks count only literal successful npm run invocations (standalone or pure && chains) whose start/end source fingerprints equal final source. Unrecognized shell syntax remains unverified; this is not a compiler-selection proof.
Light required checks retain runtime admitted-obligation reporting; independent five-endpoint grading remains separate.
No remote solution retrieval permitted. Audit applies only allowed source changes to immutable input plus pinned dependencies.
One common F65 feedback fix across both Light arms; F66 changes grouped reads only, F67 changes direct compiler repair only.
Observed cost stop applies to this newly registered campaign; prior studies are not counted as new spending. A 0.5 USD scheduling reserve is not a billing bound.
limitations: Source fingerprints do not prove environment equivalence or complete compiler/test coverage.
Passive instrumentation and nonexclusive host may affect timing; report raw duration and observer overhead.
Two repeats of two constructed tasks per panel do not establish general success or efficiency.
